note.en: No readable Geekbench 6 score was found for the Ryzen 5 3450U, so the Core i5-8250U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W class, similar era) is used as a stand-in. Public Geekbench 5 results put the two chips in the same range, but the Geekbench 6 difference was not measured.
note.zh: 没有找到 Ryzen 5 3450U 可读取的 Geekbench 6 分数，因此用同一时期、同为 4 核 8 线程、15 W 级别的 Core i5-8250U 作替代。公开的 Geekbench 5 结果显示两者处在同一水平，但 Geekbench 6 的差距没有实测。

note.en: No Geekbench 6 score is known for this CPU. The baseline is a rough estimate: the documented low-power laptop anchor (Core i5-8250U), with its multi-core score scaled by this computer's thread count.
note.zh: 这颗 CPU 没有已知的 Geekbench 6 分数。基准分数是粗略估算：取已记录的低功耗笔记本参考芯片（Core i5-8250U），并按本机线程数缩放它的多核分数。
